text.description_html:
Designer White Light Commercial Door Closer

Global Series TC30x-WH Designer White Door Closers are an economically priced door closer for use on interior or lightweight exterior door applications. Its compact design has the features and appearance of a full size closer but requires less space on a door for installation, and provides complete functionality.

The TC300 Series are commonly used on projects that specify multiple interior closers to address job conditions and budget concerns. They are an excellent choice for hotels, condominiums, apartment complex and single-family residences.

These Painted White Door Closers are non handed and can be mounted on regular or top jamb installations. They fit 6-3/8" x 3/4" mounting hole pattern and packaged complete with wood and machine screws.

Features for TC300 Series White Door Closer

  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Aluminum Alloy Shell
  • Closer Body Length: 7"
  • Horizontal Mounting Holes: 6-3/8"
  • Vertical Mounting Holes: 3/4"
  • Non Handed
  • Grade 3 Certified
  • 10 Year Warranty

Available in 2 Spring Tensions: Light #2, and Heavy #4.

Specifications for GLO-TC302-WH Light #2:

  • Maximum Door Weight: 137 lbs
  • Maximum Door Size: 32" interior

Specifications for GLO-TC304-WH Heavy #4:

  • Maximum Door Weight: 243 lbs
  • Maximum Door Size: 44" interior / 36" exterior
